beats.say: Scenes can now show real images. This is the player itself, in a screenshot.
And because nothing is rendered to a video file, links on the stage really work. Click this one, and the Mermaid docs open in a new tab, while the video pauses.

title: A question, as a sequence diagram

beats.say: Diagrams can now be real UML, and they build along with the narration. Here are the three parts involved in answering a question.
You ask a question in the player, and it's saved to the server.
The watcher picks it up, and wakes the agent.
The agent builds an answer, and the player plays it.
Class diagrams work too. A project has scenes, and each scene has beats.
A project also has comments, and a comment can have its own answer, which is another whole project. That's why answers can branch.
And here's the hand-drawn test. It's the same kind of diagram, drawn with a sketched look.
You raise your hand, and the agent answers. If the answer raises another question, the loop goes around again.
